..$comment: COUPLING (#27): consumers install a version-keyed cache of this plugin (#6), so a skills fix only reaches them once a release is cut here. This repo squash-merges, which makes the PR *title* the commit release-please reads on main — so the guarantee depends on that title carrying a releasable type. scripts/release-title-gate.sh enforces it in CI for PRs touching skills/**. Change the merge strategy (or that script's releasable set) and the guarantee has to be re-established somewhere else. JSON carries no comments; this key is inert — release-please reads named fields only, and the config schema allows extra keys inside a package entry.
